question: 上月净收入是多少？
sql: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.net_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM fact_orders AS o WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount) FROM fact_refunds AS r JOIN fact_orders AS o2 ON o2.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o2.date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031), 0) AS net_revenue LIMIT 1000
raw_sql:
SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.net_amount ELSE 0 END), 0)
   FROM fact_orders o
   WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031)
  - COALESCE(
      (SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount)
       FROM fact_refunds r
       JOIN fact_orders o2 ON o2.order_id = r.order_id
       WHERE o2.date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031), 0
    ) AS net_revenue
gold_sql:
WITH refunds AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
  FROM fact_refunds GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT ROUND(
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.net_amount ELSE 0 END)
  - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0), 2
) AS net_revenue
FROM fact_orders o
LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031

question: 上月退款率是多少？
sql: SELECT SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.net_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS refund_rate FROM fact_orders AS o LEFT JOIN fact_refunds AS r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031 LIMIT 1000
raw_sql:
SELECT SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.net_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS refund_rate
FROM fact_orders o
LEFT JOIN fact_refunds r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031
gold_sql:
WITH refunds AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
  FROM fact_refunds GROUP BY order_id
),
gmv AS (
  SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS gmv FROM fact_orders
  WHERE date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031
    AND status <> 'cancelled'
),
refund AS (
  SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_amount
  FROM fact_orders o JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031
    AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
)
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(refund.refund_amount, 0) / NULLIF(gmv.gmv, 0), 4) AS refund_rate
FROM gmv, refund

question: 本月销售额最高的品类是什么？

question: 上月毛利率是多少？
sql: WITH paid_orders AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.net_amount FROM fact_orders AS o WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031 AND o.status <> 'cancelled'), order_refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_amount FROM fact_refunds AS r GROUP BY r.order_id), order_cost AS (SELECT oi.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * p.cost) AS cost FROM fact_order_items AS oi JOIN dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY oi.order_id) SELECT (SUM(po.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(orfr.refund_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(oc.cost), 0)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(po.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(orfr.refund_amount), 0), 0) AS gross_margin FROM paid_orders AS po LEFT JOIN order_refunds AS orfr ON orfr.order_id = po.order_id LEFT JOIN order_cost AS oc ON oc.order_id = po.order_id LIMIT 1000
raw_sql:
WITH paid_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.net_amount
  FROM fact_orders o
  WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031
    AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
),
order_refunds AS (
  SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_amount
  FROM fact_refunds r
  GROUP BY r.order_id
),
order_cost AS (
  SELECT oi.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * p.cost) AS cost
  FROM fact_order_items oi
  JOIN dim_products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY oi.order_id
)
SELECT (
    SUM(po.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(orfr.refund_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(oc.cost), 0)
  ) * 1.0 / NULLIF(
    SUM(po.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(orfr.refund_amount), 0), 0
  ) AS gross_margin
FROM paid_orders po
LEFT JOIN order_refunds orfr ON orfr.order_id = po.order_id
LEFT JOIN order_cost oc ON oc.order_id = po.order_id
gold_sql:
WITH refunds AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
  FROM fact_refunds GROUP BY order_id
),
revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.net_amount ELSE 0 END)
         - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS revenue
  FROM fact_orders o
  LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031
),
cost AS (
  SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.cost) AS cost
  FROM fact_orders o
  JOIN fact_order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN dim_products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031
    AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
)
SELECT ROUND((revenue.revenue - cost.cost) / NULLIF(revenue.revenue, 0), 4) AS gross_margin
FROM revenue, cost

question: 本月至今 GMV 环比上月同期增长率
sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20261101 AND 20261105 THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261005 THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261005 THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS gmv_growth_rate FROM fact_orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND (date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261005 OR date_id BETWEEN 20261101 AND 20261105) LIMIT 1000
raw_sql:
SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20261101 AND 20261105 THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261005 THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261005 THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS gmv_growth_rate
FROM fact_orders
WHERE status <> 'cancelled'
  AND (date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261005 OR date_id BETWEEN 20261101 AND 20261105)
gold_sql:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS gmv FROM fact_orders
  WHERE date_id BETWEEN 20261101 AND 20261105 AND status <> 'cancelled'
),
prev AS (
  SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS gmv FROM fact_orders
  WHERE date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261005 AND status <> 'cancelled'
)
SELECT ROUND((cur.gmv - prev.gmv) / NULLIF(prev.gmv, 0), 4) AS gmv_growth
FROM cur, prev

question: 各区域上月退款率对比
sql: SELECT reg.region_group AS region_group, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.net_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS refund_rate FROM fact_orders AS o JOIN dim_regions AS reg ON o.region_id = reg.region_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount FROM fact_refunds GROUP BY order_id) AS r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031 GROUP BY reg.region_group ORDER BY refund_rate DESC LIMIT 1000
raw_sql:
SELECT reg.region_group AS region_group,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.net_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS refund_rate
FROM fact_orders o
JOIN dim_regions reg ON o.region_id = reg.region_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
    FROM fact_refunds
    GROUP BY order_id
) r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031
GROUP BY reg.region_group
ORDER BY refund_rate DESC
gold_sql:
WITH refunds AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
  FROM fact_refunds GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT r.region_group,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(rf.refund_amount), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(o.net_amount), 0), 4) AS refund_rate
FROM fact_orders o
JOIN dim_regions r ON r.region_id = o.region_id
LEFT JOIN refunds rf ON rf.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY r.region_group
ORDER BY refund_rate DESC, r.region_group

question: 本月 vs 上月 GMV 增长率
sql: WITH monthly_gmv AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031 AND status <> 'cancelled' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS last_month_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20261101 AND 20261105 AND status <> 'cancelled' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS current_month_gmv FROM fact_orders) SELECT (current_month_gmv - last_month_gmv) * 1.0 / NULLIF(last_month_gmv, 0) AS gmv_growth_rate FROM monthly_gmv LIMIT 1000
raw_sql:

  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031 AND status <> 'cancelled' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS last_month_gmv,
    SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20261101 AND 20261105 AND status <> 'cancelled' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS current_month_gmv
  FROM fact_orders
)
SELECT
  (current_month_gmv - last_month_gmv) * 1.0 / NULLIF(last_month_gmv, 0) AS gmv_growth_rate
FROM monthly_gmv

  WHERE date_id BETWEEN 20261101 AND 20261105 AND status <> 'cancelled'
),
prev AS (
  SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS gmv FROM fact_orders
  WHERE date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031 AND status <> 'cancelled'
)
SELECT ROUND((cur.gmv - prev.gmv) / NULLIF(prev.gmv, 0), 4) AS gmv_growth
FROM cur, prev

question: 上月复购率是多少？
sql: WITH per_customer AS (SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS customer_order_count FROM fact_orders AS o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031 GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN customer_order_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS repeat_purchase_rate FROM per_customer LIMIT 1000
raw_sql:
WITH per_customer AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS customer_order_count
  FROM fact_orders o
  WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND o.date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN customer_order_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS repeat_purchase_rate
FROM per_customer
gold_sql:
WITH customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS cnt
  FROM fact_orders
  WHERE date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031
    AND status <> 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cnt >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS repeat_rate
FROM customers

question: 8-10 月连续 3 个月 GMV 增长的品类
sql: WITH monthly_category_gmv AS (SELECT p.category, d.month_num, SUM(oi.amount) AS gmv FROM fact_order_items AS oi JOIN fact_orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN dim_dates AS d ON d.date_id = o.date_id JOIN dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.date_id BETWEEN 20260801 AND 20261031 GROUP BY p.category, d.month_num) SELECT category FROM monthly_category_gmv GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT month_num) = 3 AND SUM(CASE WHEN month_num = 8 THEN gmv END) < SUM(CASE WHEN month_num = 9 THEN gmv END) AND SUM(CASE WHEN month_num = 9 THEN gmv END) < SUM(CASE WHEN month_num = 10 THEN gmv END) LIMIT 1000
raw_sql:
WITH monthly_category_gmv AS (
  SELECT
    p.category,
    d.month_num,
    SUM(oi.amount) AS gmv
  FROM fact_order_items oi
  JOIN fact_orders o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN dim_dates d
    ON d.date_id = o.date_id
  JOIN dim_products p
    ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND o.date_id BETWEEN 20260801 AND 20261031
  GROUP BY p.category, d.month_num
)
SELECT category
FROM monthly_category_gmv
GROUP BY category
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT month_num) = 3
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN month_num = 8 THEN gmv END)
     < SUM(CASE WHEN month_num = 9 THEN gmv END)
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN month_num = 9 THEN gmv END)
     < SUM(CASE WHEN month_num = 10 THEN gmv END)
gold_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT p.category, d.month_num, SUM(oi.amount) AS gmv
  FROM fact_orders o
  JOIN fact_order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN dim_products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN dim_dates d ON d.date_id = o.date_id
  WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND d.year_num = 2026 AND d.month_num BETWEEN 8 AND 10
  GROUP BY p.category, d.month_num
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT category,
         MAX(CASE WHEN month_num = 8 THEN gmv END) AS aug_gmv,
         MAX(CASE WHEN month_num = 9 THEN gmv END) AS sep_gmv,
         MAX(CASE WHEN month_num = 10 THEN gmv END) AS oct_gmv
  FROM monthly GROUP BY category
)
SELECT category
FROM pivoted
WHERE aug_gmv < sep_gmv AND sep_gmv < oct_gmv
ORDER BY category

question: 各区域复购率

question: 本月 GMV 同比去年同月
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20261101 AND 20261105 AND status <> 'cancelled' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS current_month_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20251101 AND 20251105 AND status <> 'cancelled' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS last_year_same_month_gmv, (SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20261101 AND 20261105 AND status <> 'cancelled' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20251101 AND 20251105 AND status <> 'cancelled' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20251101 AND 20251105 AND status <> 'cancelled' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS yoy_growth_rate FROM fact_orders LIMIT 1000
raw_sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20261101 AND 20261105 AND status <> 'cancelled' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS current_month_gmv,
  SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20251101 AND 20251105 AND status <> 'cancelled' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS last_year_same_month_gmv,
  (
    SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20261101 AND 20261105 AND status <> 'cancelled' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20251101 AND 20251105 AND status <> 'cancelled' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END)
  ) * 1.0
  / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20251101 AND 20251105 AND status <> 'cancelled' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS yoy_growth_rate
FROM fact_orders

WITH cur AS (

  WHERE date_id BETWEEN 20261101 AND 20261105 AND status <> 'cancelled'
),
prev AS (
  SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS gmv FROM fact_orders
  WHERE date_id BETWEEN 20251101 AND 20251105 AND status <> 'cancelled'
)
SELECT ROUND((cur.gmv - prev.gmv) / NULLIF(prev.gmv, 0), 4) AS yoy_growth
FROM cur, prev

question: 10 月和 11 月各区域退款率（返回两个月退款率）
sql: WITH order_refunds AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount FROM fact_refunds GROUP BY order_id) SELECT reg.region_group AS region_group, SUM(CASE WHEN o.date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031 THEN COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031 AND o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.net_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS refund_rate_202610, SUM(CASE WHEN o.date_id BETWEEN 20261101 AND 20261105 THEN COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.date_id BETWEEN 20261101 AND 20261105 AND o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.net_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS refund_rate_202611 FROM fact_orders AS o JOIN dim_regions AS reg ON o.region_id = reg.region_id LEFT JOIN order_refunds AS r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261105 GROUP BY reg.region_group LIMIT 1000
raw_sql:
WITH order_refunds AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
    FROM fact_refunds
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
    reg.region_group AS region_group,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031 THEN COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031 AND o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.net_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS refund_rate_202610,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.date_id BETWEEN 20261101 AND 20261105 THEN COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.date_id BETWEEN 20261101 AND 20261105 AND o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN o.net_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS refund_rate_202611
FROM fact_orders o
JOIN dim_regions reg ON o.region_id = reg.region_id
LEFT JOIN order_refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261105
GROUP BY reg.region_group
gold_sql:
WITH refunds AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
  FROM fact_refunds GROUP BY order_id
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT r.region_group, d.month_num,
         SUM(o.net_amount) AS gmv,
         COALESCE(SUM(rf.refund_amount), 0) AS refund_amount
  FROM fact_orders o
  JOIN dim_regions r ON r.region_id = o.region_id
  JOIN dim_dates d ON d.date_id = o.date_id
  LEFT JOIN refunds rf ON rf.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND d.year_num = 2026 AND d.month_num IN (10, 11)
  GROUP BY r.region_group, d.month_num
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT region_group,
         MAX(CASE WHEN month_num = 10 THEN refund_amount / NULLIF(gmv, 0) END) AS oct_rate,
         MAX(CASE WHEN month_num = 11 THEN refund_amount / NULLIF(gmv, 0) END) AS nov_rate
  FROM monthly GROUP BY region_group
)
SELECT region_group,
       ROUND(oct_rate, 4) AS oct_rate,
       ROUND(nov_rate, 4) AS nov_rate
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY region_group

category_stats AS (
  SELECT
    co.category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT co.order_id) AS order_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) AS refund_order_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT co.order_id), 0) AS return_rate
  FROM categorized_orders co
  LEFT JOIN fact_refunds r ON r.order_id = co.order_id
  GROUP BY co.category
),
store_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT po.order_id) AS order_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) AS refund_order_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT po.order_id), 0) AS return_rate
  FROM paid_orders po
  LEFT JOIN fact_refunds r ON r.order_id = po.order_id
)
SELECT cs.category
FROM category_stats cs
CROSS JOIN store_stats ss
WHERE cs.return_rate > ss.return_rate
gold_sql:
WITH categories AS (
  SELECT p.category,
         COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS return_rate
  FROM fact_orders o
  JOIN fact_order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN dim_products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  LEFT JOIN fact_refunds r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20261001 AND 20261031
    AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY p.category
)
SELECT category, ROUND(return_rate, 4) AS return_rate
FROM categories
WHERE return_rate > (SELECT AVG(return_rate) FROM categories)
ORDER BY return_rate DESC, category

question: 连续 3 个月毛利率下降的品类
gold_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT p.category, d.month_num,
         SUM(oi.amount) AS revenue,
         SUM(oi.quantity * p.cost) AS cost
  FROM fact_orders o
  JOIN fact_order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN dim_products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN dim_dates d ON d.date_id = o.date_id
  WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND d.year_num = 2026 AND d.month_num BETWEEN 8 AND 10
  GROUP BY p.category, d.month_num
),
margins AS (
  SELECT category, month_num,
         (revenue - cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(revenue, 0) AS margin
  FROM monthly
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT category,
         MAX(CASE WHEN month_num = 8 THEN margin END) AS aug_margin,
         MAX(CASE WHEN month_num = 9 THEN margin END) AS sep_margin,
         MAX(CASE WHEN month_num = 10 THEN margin END) AS oct_margin
  FROM margins GROUP BY category
)
SELECT category
FROM pivoted
WHERE aug_margin > sep_margin AND sep_margin > oct_margin
ORDER BY category
